ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pill O-Clock uses the camera to scan the barcode on a medication package and fill in the medication details.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pill O-Clock uses your photos so you can attach a picture of the package to each medication.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pill O-Clock uses your location to pin the exact place of your medical appointments on the map.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Pill O-Clock uses Face ID to unlock the app when app lock is turned on.
